verdict.rationale: Anomaly and duplicate detection is a fair question for a bookkeeping service, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents an agent or AI feature that flags spend anomalies or duplicate transactions before close. The AI features shown cover categorization only, and "real-time transaction monitoring" for cards describes visibility, not anomaly flagging. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec through which an external agent could watch the ledger.
